scripts.title: ESP
scripts.script:
game:GetService("RunService").RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    for _, v in pairs(workspace.Runners.Skinwalkers:GetChildren()) do
        if v:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
            local h = v:FindFirstChildOfClass("Highlight") or Instance.new("Highlight", v)
            local humanoid = v.Humanoid

            if humanoid.Health > 0 then
                h.FillColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
                h.OutlineTransparency = 1
            else
                h:Destroy()
            end
        end
    end
end)

scripts.title: esp
scripts.script:
local ESP = loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://kiriot22.com/releases/ESP.lua"))()
ESP:Toggle(true)

ESP.Players = false
ESP.Boxes = true
ESP.Names = true

ESP:AddObjectListener(workspace.Runners.Skinwalkers, {
    Type = "Model",
    PrimaryPart = "HumanoidRootPart",
    CustomName = "Skinwalker",
    Color = Color3.fromRGB(33, 0, 33),
    IsEnabled = "SkinwalkerESPEnabled"
})

ESP.SkinwalkerESPEnabled = true
